name: ai-dataset
description: AI training dataset review (TASK-27 step 4): the admin-only AI Dataset page (/training-review, AI navbar dropdown) where a human labels captured AI training samples and freezes an eval set, the /server/training-samples/* routes behind it, the read-only mining script scripts/mine_failures.py, and the step 5 scoring: lib/family_prompts.py + lib/comparators.py and scripts/score_eval.py (scores one pinned AI profile, no fallback, on the eval rows), and the read-only step 6 export scripts/export_dataset.py (dataset-combined-vN for the top-level training/ folder), and step 4h: scripts/seed_from_trees.py (screen-id samples from the node screenshots of the canonical apps, train only), the coverage report (lib/dataset_scope.py, lib/dataset_coverage.py, scripts/coverage_report.py, GET /server/training-samples/coverage, the Coverage panel), and step 4i AI triage: scripts/triage_batch.py (export a blind batch for an AI worker, import its answers: agreed with the run label / needs_human / teacher_only; --second-pass settles what the first answer could not, or marks it excluded: never trained, never sent to the human), lib/label_schema.py + lib/label_write.py (the shared label write) + lib/triage_db.py, the 'Needs you' view and the eval-vN-ai freeze (human + AI-agreed), and the feature-only migrations db/001_triage.sql (ai_training_samples.triage) and db/002_triage_excluded.sql (the excluded status), applied by hand, and step 4l: scripts/focus_text_pass.py (an AI reads the visible focus text of grouped screen-id rows into ground_truth.focus, label_source kept). NOT this feature: capturing the samples. The capture helper (shared/src/lib/ai/training_samples.py), the DB module (ai_training_samples_db.py), the migration (setup/db/migrations/20260927a_ai_training_samples.sql), the capture hooks (navigation executor, incident manager / alerts + script results, zap detector, ai_utils vision), get_training_storage() in cloudflare_utils and the .env.example TRAINING_DATA_ENABLED block are core and inert by default. Core keeps inert hooks only; the full list is in README.md ('Core hooks'): the '/training-review' -> ai.training:view entry in PAGE_PERMISSIONS (gates the nav item and the page), the ai.training:view/review permissions (auth.ts, PermissionChecklist, auth_middleware ADMIN_ONLY_PERMISSIONS, server_permissions_routes). Design: docs/tasks/TASK-27-ai-training-dataset.md.
